glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Race/faction of giant humanoid warriors; main antagonists.
Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Boddole Zer's main Zentradi fleet that the Macross and Nadesico attack.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Female Zentradi faction, at war with the male Zentradi in DYRL.
Network of (hundreds of) orbital military satellite cannons of the Rainen Project; Gun Ark/Buster Ark can call it via the Guardian System.
Latest Ark-series transforming machine from the UCE Design Bureau; Tak's (and initially Marina's red) unit; can call Guardian satellite strikes.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?

glossary.role: Supreme commander of the Zentradi main fleet.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness

glossary.role: Orphan's disc plates sought by the Reclaimers; ALSO (crossover) inscribed plates carrying a Zentradi/Protoculture song.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: SDF-1 Macross, the U.N. Spacy super-dimensional fortress (human flagship).
ACE2 protagonist; UCE squad leader (First Lieutenant) and Gun Ark test pilot, joins the Albion unit.
glossary.personality: Skilled ace and natural leader, but clumsy with machines (mechanically inept); grows suspicious of the Rainen Project and fights to bring Marina back.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Short for Boddole Zer's fleet: ボドル基幹艦隊 (main fleet), ボドル艦隊 (fleet), ボドル旗艦 (flagship).
ACE2 heroine; Ensign in Tak's squad, pilot of the red Gun Ark; goes missing at Torrington Base, reappears with the Rainen Project in the Buster Ark, later rejoins Tak.
glossary.personality: Cool and reserved ('defrosting ice queen' in flashbacks); deeply bonded with Tak.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

37.speaker: Eyphar Sinapus
37.evidence: brief: '私が本艦の艦長、エイパー・シナプスだ。'

38.speaker: South Burning
38.role: Captain, mobile weapons unit commander at Torrington

rows.jp: オペレーション　２７
rows.en: Operation 27

rows.jp: バスターアーク戦
rows.en: Battle with the Buster Ark

rows.jp:
<ac(27)><op(37,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]ブリタイ艦隊#cは、<im(2)>先ほど地<im(1)>球との和<im(3)>平条約を
破棄し、#c[BE5050]ボドル基幹艦隊#cと合流した。
rows.en:
<ac(27)><op(37,1)><sp(2)>The #c[BE5050]Vrlitwhai Fleet#c has just <im(2)>broken the peace treaty<im(1)><im(3)>
with Earth and rendezvoused with the
#c[BE5050]Boddole Main Fleet#c.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>歌が完成すれば対#c[BE5050]メルトランディ#cの切り札に
するつもりだったようだが…
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>They seemingly intended to use the completed song
as a trump card against the #c[BE5050]Meltrandi#c, but...
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>２つ目のプレートの解読が長引いたことで、
しびれを切らしたのだろう。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>With deciphering of the second plate dragging on,
they must have lost their patience.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(11)>５０<im(12)>０万<im(13)>隻も<im(14)>の戦<im(15)>闘艦<im(16)>艇を<im(19)>有す<im(20)>る
#c[BE5050]ボ<im(21)>ドル<im(22)>基幹艦隊#cはすでに地球近辺に
展開している。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(11)>Possessing <im(12)>over <im(13)>5,000,000 <im(14)>combat <im(15)>vessels, <im(16)>the <im(19)>great <im(20)>#c[BE5050]Bod<im(21)>dole <im(22)>Main Fleet#c
has already deployed near Earth.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>…戦闘になれば、地球圏の現有戦力では
手も足も出ないだろう。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>...If it comes to battle, the Earth Sphere's existing
forces will not stand a chance.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>絶望的な状況だ…
<im(4)>我々としては、できる限りの準備をする。
…それ以外にはないだろう。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>It is a desperate situation...
<im(4)>All we can do is make whatever preparations we can.
...There is nothing else.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>これより本艦は、<im(7)><im(6)><im(8)>#c[5E8FD8]ナデシコ#c、#c[5E8FD8]マクロス#cとともに
#c[F07141]ゼントラーディ、メルトランディとの決戦#cに
向かわねばならない。が、その前に……
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Our ship, <im(7)><im(6)><im(8)>alongside the #c[5E8FD8]Nadesico#c and #c[5E8FD8]Macross#c,
must head into #c[F07141]the decisive battle against the Zentradi
and Meltrandi#c. But before that...
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>本艦の行く手に#c[BE5050]バスターアーク#cが
確認されている。どうやら、#c[BE5050]ガーディアン#cで
我々に狙いを定めているようだ。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>The #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c has been spotted in our path.
It appears to have set its sights on us
with the #c[BE5050]Guardian#c.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>こんな状況で出て来るとはな…
しかし、これは考えようによっては
我々にとってもチャンスかも知れん。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>To think she would emerge in a situation like this...
Yet, depending on how we look at it,
this might also be an opportunity for us.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(18)>#c[BE5050]カーソン少尉#cを保護すれば、
あの機体の本来の機能についての
情報を得ることができる。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(18)>If we can secure #c[BE5050]Ensign Carson#c,
we can obtain intelligence regarding
that machine's true functions.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>それは、この絶望的な状況において
有効な対抗手段となるかもしれない。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>That intelligence may serve as an effective
countermeasure in this desperate situation.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>いずれにせよ、我々に選択肢はないのだ。
ここで勝負をつけないことには、
我々は一歩も先には進めん。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>In any case, we have no choice.
Unless we settle this contest here,
we cannot take a single step forward.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>わずかな希望を信じて……
作戦を実行する。
全員で出撃準備にかかってくれ。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Believing in our faint glimmer of hope...
we will carry out this mission.
Prepare for sortie, all hands.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(43,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]ボドルザー#cが到着するまであとわず<im(17)>かです。
<of(1)>…決着は早めにつけます！
rows.en:
<op(43,1)><sp(2)>Only a short time remains before #c[BE5050]Boddole Zer#c arrives.<im(17)>
<of(1)>...I will settle this quickly!
rows.notes: Tak Kepford resolve. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>最後の行動に出てきた、
<im(2)>というこ<im(1)>とだろう<im(3)>な。
rows.en: <op(38,1)><sp(2)>This must be her <im(2)>making her <im(1)>final move.<im(3)>
rows.notes: Burning tactical briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>周辺には残存部隊であろう
<im(7)>#c[E2E258]ライ<im(8)>ネンシリーズ#cも確認されている。
rows.en:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>Units from the <im(7)>#c[E2E258]Rai<im(8)>nen Series#c have also been
identified nearby, likely remaining forces.
rows.notes: Burning tactical briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>もう言うことはない。
<im(4)>とにかく#c[F07141]思いっきり戦って、生きて帰っ<im(6)>て来い#c。<tr(1)>
rows.en:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>I have nothing more to say.
<im(4)>Just #c[F07141]fight with everything you have, and come back <im(6)>alive#c.<tr(1)>
rows.notes: Burning tactical briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]カーソン#cも連れて帰って来いよ。
いいかげんに目を覚まさせてやらないとな。
rows.en:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>Bring #c[BE5050]Carson#c back with you, too.
It is high time we woke her up.
rows.notes: Burning tactical briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Buster Ark... incoming!!<ab(300)><ed()>

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op27_01. Covers Captain Sinapus's strategic briefing on the 5-million-ship Boddole Main Fleet and the Buster Ark's intercept position, Burning's tactical briefing, and the emotional duel during atmospheric reentry between Tak in Gun Ark and Marina in Buster Ark, culminating in Marina's unit being disabled and Sinapus attempting to negotiate her surrender.
